name: Risk
changeLabel: The device is confirmed to be in a lab
originalFact: The same laptop is missing from the MDM inventory twice. Its owner and an open service desk item are known.
changedFact: The device is confirmed as a lab asset with no route to production. The lab boundary is documented.
originalMove: Check the provisioning process and extend the work already open. Keep both dates as evidence that the miss repeated.
changedMove: Verify that the lab boundary still holds, then exclude this asset from the production control story. Do not close other device findings by association.

name: Controls
originalFact: A public-assets setting matches a current, approved design exception.
changedFact: The same setting is still present, but the approved exception expired yesterday.
originalMove: Keep the accepted signal tied to that asset and reason. Watch for changes outside the approved scope.
changedMove: Ask the owner whether the control claim still holds. Renew, narrow, or end the exception before treating the signal as accepted.

name: Vendors
changeLabel: The lab connects to customer transcripts
originalFact: The CRM team evaluates Nimbus with invented calls inside a documented lab boundary.
changedFact: The CRM team connects Nimbus to live customer transcripts. The vendor report has not changed.
originalMove: Proceed with the bounded evaluation and name the person who will end access after the trial.
changedMove: Reopen the engagement decision. Check retention, the production connector, and who can accept the new data path.

name: Judgment
changeLabel: Two useful conversations are now recorded
originalFact: A past rule looks relevant, but there is no record of how this team has worked with Security.
changedFact: Two relevant conversations with this team are now documented, including how it handled an earlier trade-off.
originalMove: Use the rule to frame questions. Leave the team-history judgment unknown until someone supplies evidence.
changedMove: Read those conversations against the rule's limits and counterexample. The new history permits a better judgment, not an automatic one.
